title: Authoritative native fiber specialization and full selected-fiber allocation accounting
status: Implementation and local qualification complete and retained for native exact certificates, evaluator deduplication, and modest slow-fixture/size improvements. Nonuniform performance is explicitly recorded. Full Hypercurve release readiness and the overarching objective remain open.
exactcorelib_mining_and_idea_uplift: Already closed by preceding checkpoints; this follow-on kernel cleanup does not newly close that milestone.

change.scalar_authority: Real::eval_poly owns exact polynomial evaluation and its native certificates.
change.geometry_authority: Existing bivariate_specialize_second and the rank-preserving dense last-axis specialization feed the existing CurveRegion2 machinery.

tests.name: fiber_specialization_retains_native_quadratic_root_certificates
tests.before: Legacy evaluator returned Unknown for a reconstructed quadratic root.
tests.after: ZeroKnowledge::Zero for both roots and three signed symbolic scales through bivariate and dense specialization.
tests.scope: Certificate preservation, not a claim that the old numerical value was wrong or that a previously observed end-to-end Boolean blocker was fixed.

tests.name: fiber_specialization_preserves_axis_order_and_ragged_zero_rows
tests.before: Passed after correcting the independent oracle's zero-to-zero power convention.
tests.after: Passed; ragged zero/constant rows and rank-preserving [2,3,4] -> [2,3,1] specialization agree with a power-sum oracle.

change.dense_contract: Retains the last axis at width one. Hypersolve's private substitute_axis_value removes an axis, so it was not exposed or wrapped as a replacement.
change.fuzz_oracle: Existing nonmonotone_coordinate_image_is_certified_without_sampling regression proves the complete image. The stale fuzz assertion expecting XImageFailed is replaced with Transformed plus exact coordinate coefficients and strict bounds.

passed_gates.gate: Minimal release, 46 suites; four opt-in cases covered in all-feature run
UI release WASM, restored current-workspace artifact

memory.includes: Entire successful libtest process; requested heap bytes, including initialization, test harness, and process-lifetime caches. Not allocator usable-size, stack memory, or a leak diagnosis.
memory.method: Heaptrack --raw --record-only, followed by validated streaming event accounting. Both complete decompression/accounting pipelines exited 0.
memory.recorder_timing_limitation: Instrumented durations are not A/B wall-clock performance evidence; builds and failed interpreter attempts overlapped recording.
memory.raw_temporary_definition: An allocation whose pointer is the next freed pointer before any other allocation/free; matches Heaptrack 1.5 interpreter, not necessarily its printer's allocation-index-based temporary count.

counter_validation.independent_checks: Heaptrack interpreter counts and end-live blocks agree exactly; Heaptrack histogram weighted size total and count agree exactly. Printer peak/end-live byte display agrees at its published precision.

interpreter_failures.ordinary: Two global OOM kills, at 61,521,036 and 62,998,448 KiB anonymous RSS.
interpreter_failures.bounded_symbol_free: Hard 12 GiB address-space cap stopped a symbol-free retry with bad_alloc.
interpreter_failures.diagnostic: GDB caught allocation failure in AllocationInfoSet's robin_hash rehash; no application failure is inferred.
interpreter_failures.treatment: All partial interpreted files excluded from successful memory evidence.

memory.top_stack: A highest-count leaf allocation trace passes through BigUint division/reduction, Rational addition, LocalAlgebraicField::add_polynomials, and local-field Bernstein root isolation during selected-parameter promotion. This is not an aggregate function-dominance claim.

timing.observed_regression: Cached rational point incidence repeats at 148.1038 -> 176.752 ns (+19.34%, +28.6482 ns). Retained as an explicit performance cost, not dismissed as noise.

instruction_controls.includes: Whole process, fixture construction, both warm-ups, and measured independent/shared all-four Boolean batches.
instruction_controls.caveat: Circles increase 0.04474%; this is not a strict no-instruction-regression pass.

timing.checksum_caveat: Checksums agree as strings, but zero/XOR accumulators are not independent geometry-correctness proofs.
timing.driver_source:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
fiber_evidence="/home/tim/Documents/GitHub/workspace/hypercurve/target/native-fiber-profile.brJ3C6"
fiber_frozen="/tmp/hypercurve-native-fiber.ibZ6fB"
for fiber_round in 1 2 3; do
    if (( fiber_round % 2 )); then
        fiber_order="baseline candidate"
    else
        fiber_order="candidate baseline"
    fi
    for fiber_case in selected chord radial; do
        case "$fiber_case" in
            selected) fiber_test="bezier_offset::conversion_tests::selected_fiber_genuinely_analytic_contacts_complete_region_booleans" ;;
            chord) fiber_test="bezier_offset::conversion_tests::recursive_selected_radial_diameter_chord_intersects_a_rational_quadratic_strict" ;;
            radial) fiber_test="bezier_offset::conversion_tests::recursively_pair_radial_circle_intersects_a_genuine_analytic_parallel" ;;
        esac
        for fiber_variant in $fiber_order; do
            /usr/bin/time -f 'elapsed_s=%e user_s=%U system_s=%S max_rss_kib=%M exit=%x' \
                -o "$fiber_evidence/wall-$fiber_case-$fiber_round-$fiber_variant.time" \
                taskset -c 7 "$fiber_frozen/$fiber_variant-test" "$fiber_test" \
                --exact --include-ignored --test-threads=1 \
                > "$fiber_evidence/wall-$fiber_case-$fiber_round-$fiber_variant.log" 2>&1
        done
    done
    for fiber_bench in bezier_region rational_bezier; do
        for fiber_variant in $fiber_order; do
            /usr/bin/time -f 'elapsed_s=%e user_s=%U system_s=%S max_rss_kib=%M exit=%x' \
                -o "$fiber_evidence/wall-$fiber_bench-$fiber_round-$fiber_variant.time" \
                taskset -c 7 "$fiber_evidence/$fiber_variant-$fiber_bench" \
                > "$fiber_evidence/wall-$fiber_bench-$fiber_round-$fiber_variant.log" 2>&1
        done
    done
    for fiber_fixture in rectangles circles capsules; do
        unset HYPERCURVE_CURVE_REGION_BATCH_FIXTURE
        if [[ "$fiber_fixture" != rectangles ]]; then
            export HYPERCURVE_CURVE_REGION_BATCH_FIXTURE="$fiber_fixture"
        fi
        for fiber_variant in $fiber_order; do
            HYPERCURVE_CURVE_REGION_BATCH_ITERATIONS=1000 \
                taskset -c 7 "$fiber_evidence/$fiber_variant-curve_region_boolean_batch" \
                > "$fiber_evidence/wall-$fiber_fixture-$fiber_round-$fiber_variant.log" 2>&1
        done
    done
done
timing.retention_reason: Native certificate preservation/completeness takes priority over the small absolute cache-path cost; production evaluator and linked code shrink, while all three slow-fixture medians improve. Uniform performance is not claimed.

size.note: Both WASM builds and native benchmark pairs use the same source directory and Cargo target directory; the isolated snapshot was changed only after baseline artifacts were frozen.
size.unit_binary_caveat: The candidate libtest binary adds two tests and is 58,224 bytes larger; it is not used as a production size comparison.
size.no_layout_change: No production carrier fields or public types changed.

earlier_invalid_attempts: Initial /tmp Heaptrack recordings failed under disk quota exhaustion; only exact owned producer PIDs were terminated after their consumers had exited.
An all-feature test log in /tmp was quota-truncated and exit 101 was inconclusive; the complete workspace-filesystem rerun passed.
The first independent polynomial test oracle attempted 0^0. Its constant term was corrected before the authoritative before/after regression replay.
remaining: Full Hypercurve release readiness and uniform geometry performance remain open.
This is complete memory accounting for one slow fixture, not every long-running fixture or the pathological retained-input matrix.
Caller source scanning is not downstream caller build/corpus qualification.
No push, publication, deployment, browser run, or coverage campaign is claimed.
Cached-incidence latency and the small circle instruction increase remain performance follow-ups; inspect inclusive allocation attribution before changing local-field root isolation or promotion.
